name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: Largest quake M6.4 in the past week; no PAGER alerts
state: USGS recorded four earthquakes of M6 or above in the seven days to 4 Nov, the largest an M6.4 south-east of Easter Island on 29 Oct; others struck near Vanuatu and off Japan. There was no M7+ event, no PAGER orange or red alert and no tsunami warning.
for_you: No action needed. Follow local civil-defence advice in earthquake zones.
rubric_hit: Max M6.4 < M7; PAGER green = Normal
why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
